headline: Cursor supply chain attack traced to Fireworks AI; Fandango checkout skimming; Barracuda hacked amid ARTEX-powered attack surge

bullets.text: New: SecurityWeek reports the Cursor supply chain attack started at Fireworks AI. The brief gives no affected versions; teams using Cursor or Fireworks AI should follow vendor guidance as it lands. 300 malicious npm and PyPI packages were also listed in the last 7 days.

New: Fandango says hackers stole payment card details from its checkout pages. Coles is investigating an incident, Uber's breach impacts 150,000 people and Qilin claims UT Arlington; Lithuania's customs agency restored services after a cyberattack.

Still active: Barracuda was hacked amid a surge in ARTEX-powered cyberattacks; the FBI's ARTEX warning remains the only 3-outlet story. Barracuda CVE-2026-111560 and ESG CVE-2026-116606 went on KEV 11-10 with an 11-13 deadline.

Due today: UnrealIRCd CVE-2026-114713 is exploited in attacks and Check Point CVE-2026-123039 shares the 11-16 KEV deadline. BO Team exploited Log4Shell in VMware vCenter to compromise a code-signing server.

AI-driven attacks: Amazon uncovered an AI agent campaign hunting LiteLLM, Dify and other apps for API keys, SANS sees scans for CVE-2026-42271 and CVE-2026-48710, and Google says an AI agent turned a patch into a working exploit unaided.
Trend: SITCON 3 (ELEVATED), unchanged. The last 7 days score 1.01x the 90-day average; INC Ransom led leak-site claims with 51 this week.

actions: Cursor and Fireworks AI users: review vendor advisories, check installed extensions and builds, and rotate tokens or API keys those tools can reach.
E-commerce teams: audit checkout page scripts for unauthorized changes and enforce a strict script allowlist or CSP.
UnrealIRCd and Check Point: patch CVE-2026-114713 and CVE-2026-123039 today or pull exposed systems offline, then hunt for backdoors.
Barracuda: confirm CVE-2026-111560 and ESG CVE-2026-116606 are fixed and review appliances for signs of compromise.
LiteLLM, Dify and other AI gateways: patch CVE-2026-42271 and CVE-2026-48710, keep admin endpoints private and rotate stored API keys.
Queue KEV fixes: Apple CVE-2024-27834 due 11-18, SonicWall SSLVPN 11-20, Outlook, Cisco BroadWorks, Openwave and Chromium 11-24.
